$comment: Perform mode: the public setlist listing (/perform), the setlist perform view (/perform/setlist/<id>), its row list, the queue drawer, and the single-chart page (/perform/<fileId>). Glossary: setlist (BL: set), chart = the sheet-music file, service, Perform mode.

songCount.where: Perform: song count on a setlist card in the public listing, and under the setlist name in the perform view header
songCount.context: {count} is the number of songs in the setlist

signedInAs.where: Public setlist listing (/perform): screen-reader label of the avatar link to Settings, top corner
signedInAs.context: {userName} is the person's display name or email (or the 'musician' fallback word)

musicianFallback.where: Public setlist listing: fallback for the person's name inside 'Signed in as … — open settings' when they have no name or email

signInTo.where: Public setlist listing: screen-reader label of the sign-in card (QR + Google)
signInTo.context: {orgName} is the congregation or band short name (e.g. 'CRC Music')

or.where: Public setlist listing sign-in card: small divider word between the QR code and the Google button (shown uppercase by CSS)

signInWithGoogle.where: Public setlist listing sign-in card: button

noPublicSetlists.where: Public setlist listing: empty state when no setlists are listed

goToNextService.where: Public setlist listing: screen-reader label of the big 'Next service' card
goToNextService.context: {setlistName} is the setlist's name (data, not translated)

nextService.where: Public setlist listing: small eyebrow heading on the big card for the soonest upcoming service (CSS uppercase)

today.where: Public setlist listing: label on the big next-service card when that service is today, shown instead of 'Next service'

perform.where: Public setlist listing: call-to-action word at the end of the 'Next service' card (opens Perform mode)

upcoming.where: Public setlist listing: section heading above upcoming setlists (CSS uppercase)

publicSetlists.where: Public setlist listing loading skeleton: subtitle under the brand name

queueTrackType.header.where: Perform mode, setlist drawer (bottom sheet): small type tag under a queue row (CSS uppercase)
queueTrackType.header.context: Section header row. English is lowercase on purpose (CSS uppercases it)

queueTrackType.reading.where: Perform mode, setlist drawer: small type tag under a queue row (CSS uppercase)
queueTrackType.reading.context: A reading (not a song). English is lowercase on purpose

queueTrackType.prayer.where: Perform mode, setlist drawer: small type tag under a queue row (CSS uppercase)
queueTrackType.prayer.context: A prayer (not a song). English is lowercase on purpose

queueTrackType.transition.where: Perform mode, setlist drawer: small type tag under a queue row (CSS uppercase)
queueTrackType.transition.context: A transition between items. English is lowercase on purpose

queueTrackType.note.where: Perform mode, setlist drawer: small type tag under a queue row (CSS uppercase)
queueTrackType.note.context: A note row. English is lowercase on purpose

liturgyRun.page.where: Perform setlist view: page number at the end of a folded run of fixed-liturgy rows
liturgyRun.page.context: {page} is the prayer-book page number; 'p.' = page. Keep the no-break space

liturgyRun.pageRange.where: Perform setlist view: page range at the end of a folded run of fixed-liturgy rows

liturgyRun.rows.where: Perform setlist view: label of a folded run of fixed-liturgy rows (rows the band does not play from)
liturgyRun.rows.context: {count} is the number of folded rows (always 2 or more; a single row shows its own title)

liturgyRun.hideRow.where: Perform setlist view: label of an opened single-row liturgy run (tap to fold it again)
liturgyRun.hideRow.context: {rowTitle} is the row's own title, lowercased (data)

liturgyRun.hideRows.where: Perform setlist view: label of an opened liturgy run (tap to fold it again)
liturgyRun.hideRows.context: {count} is the number of rows in the run (2 or more)

row.folio.where: Perform setlist view: prayer-book page column at the end of a row
row.folio.context: {page} is the page number; 'p.' = page. Keep the no-break space

row.bpm.where: Perform setlist view: tempo on a song row
row.bpm.context: {bpm} is beats per minute; 'BPM' is the musical unit

row.openChart.where: Perform setlist view and drawer: screen-reader label of a non-song row that opens a chart
row.openChart.context: {songTitle} is the row title (data). chart = sheet music

row.tonightPlanned.where: Perform setlist view: small note under a row that was swapped for tonight's service, naming what was planned
row.tonightPlanned.context: {plannedTitle} is the originally planned song title (data)

row.notSavedOffline.where: Perform setlist view: small warning line under a row whose chart is not saved on this device

row.saveFailedDownload.where: Perform setlist view: reason appended to the not-saved line when this device could not download the chart (missing file, server error or no connection)
row.saveFailedDownload.context: Follows 'Not saved offline · '. Retrying is the Save button in the header

row.saveFailedDamaged.where: Perform setlist view: reason appended to the not-saved line when the chart downloaded but its file is broken (not a readable PDF)
row.saveFailedDamaged.context: Follows 'Not saved offline · '. The file itself needs replacing; tell the band leader

row.swapForTonight.where: Perform setlist view: screen-reader label of the Swap button at the end of a row
row.swapForTonight.context: {songTitle} is the row title (data). Swap = replace this chart for tonight's service only

row.swap.where: Perform setlist view: tiny button label at the end of a row (opens 'swap for tonight')

noTracksYet.where: Perform setlist view: empty state when the setlist has no rows

drawer.connect.where: Perform toolbar: tooltip of the drawer button when no setlist is loaded (opens a list of public setlists)

drawer.setlist.where: Perform toolbar: tooltip of the drawer button when a setlist is loaded

drawer.joinSetlist.where: Perform setlist drawer (bottom sheet): title when choosing a public setlist

drawer.currentSetlist.where: Perform setlist drawer (bottom sheet): title when a setlist is loaded

drawer.loadingActive.where: Perform setlist drawer: loading text while public setlists load

drawer.noneActive.where: Perform setlist drawer: empty state when no public setlists exist

drawer.songCount.where: Perform setlist drawer: song count on a public setlist card
drawer.songCount.context: {count} is the number of songs. English reads 'songs' even for 1 (unchanged legacy text); translate with the correct plural

drawer.close.where: Perform setlist drawer: full-width close button at the bottom

error.noAccess.where: Perform setlist view: full-screen error when the setlist cannot be read

error.notFound.where: Perform setlist view: full-screen error when the setlist does not exist

error.loadFailed.where: Perform setlist view: full-screen error on a network/other failure

loadingSetlist.where: Perform setlist view: loading text under the spinner

loadingSetlistEllipsis.where: Perform setlist route loading screen (server, before the page streams in)
loadingSetlistEllipsis.context: Same meaning as loadingSetlist; English uses the single ellipsis character here

backToHome.where: Perform setlist view error screen: button back to the public listing

backToSetlists.where: Perform setlist view error screen: button back to the setlists dashboard

backToHomeLabel.where: Perform setlist view header: screen-reader label of the back arrow (to the public listing)

backToSetlistsLabel.where: Perform setlist view header: screen-reader label of the back arrow (to the setlists dashboard)

header.songsAndItems.where: Perform setlist view header: counts under the setlist name when it has non-song rows
header.songsAndItems.context: {count} = number of songs (plural form follows it); {totalCount} = all rows except section headers (English always 'items')

toolbar.showLiturgyRows.where: Perform setlist view toolbar: screen-reader label of the liturgy fold toggle when folded
toolbar.showLiturgyRows.context: {count} = number of fixed-liturgy rows that fold. English keeps 'rows' even for 1 (unchanged legacy text)

toolbar.hideLiturgyRows.where: Perform setlist view toolbar: screen-reader label of the liturgy fold toggle when unfolded
toolbar.hideLiturgyRows.context: {count} = number of fixed-liturgy rows. English keeps 'rows' even for 1 (unchanged legacy text)

toolbar.liturgy.where: Perform setlist view toolbar: visible label of the fold toggle while liturgy rows are folded (tap to show them)

toolbar.songsOnly.where: Perform setlist view toolbar: visible label of the fold toggle while liturgy rows are shown (tap to fold them)

toolbar.printSetlist.where: Perform setlist view toolbar: screen-reader label of the print button

toolbar.print.where: Perform setlist view toolbar: print button label

toolbar.editSetlist.where: Perform setlist view toolbar: screen-reader label of the edit link (opens the setlist editor)

toolbar.edit.where: Perform setlist view toolbar: edit button label

unknownMusician.where: Perform setlist view: 'who's playing' chip when a musician has no name

tonight.rowsSwapped.where: Perform setlist view: banner when rows were swapped for tonight's service only

tonight.resetToPlan.where: Perform setlist view: button in the tonight banner that undoes all tonight-only swaps

addTracks.where: Perform setlist view empty state: button that opens the setlist editor

chartError.title.where: Perform mode error screen: heading when a chart crashes while rendering

chartError.body.where: Perform mode error screen: explanation under the heading

chartError.goBack.where: Perform mode error screen: button that goes back

retry.where: Perform mode error screens: retry button

retrying.where: Single-chart page error screen: retry button while retrying

chartLoad.libraryFailed.where: Single-chart page: error detail when the chart library could not load

chartLoad.signInRequired.where: Single-chart page: error detail when the viewer is signed out

chartLoad.timedOut.where: Single-chart page: error detail after waiting too long for the chart

chartLoad.notFound.where: Single-chart page: error detail when the chart does not exist

chartLoad.fileId.where: Single-chart page error: small technical line under the error

chartLoad.library.where: Single-chart page error: button to the chart library

chartLoad.loading.where: Single-chart page: loading text under the spinner

status.updated.where: Perform setlist view: status line under the setlist name, how fresh the setlist is
status.updated.context: {when} is a relative time such as '3 hours ago' (already translated)

status.chartsOnDevice.where: Perform setlist view: status line under the setlist name, how many of the setlist's charts are saved on this tablet for offline use
status.chartsOnDevice.context: {ready}/{total} are chart counts. 'this iPad' = the tablet the musician is holding

reorder.start.where: Perform setlist view: toolbar button that turns on reorder mode
reorder.start.context: Reorder = change the order of the songs during the service, for everyone

reorder.startLabel.where: Perform setlist view: screen-reader label of the Reorder button

reorder.done.where: Perform setlist view: toolbar button that leaves reorder mode

reorder.hint.where: Perform setlist view, reorder mode: line above the list

reorder.listLabel.where: Perform setlist view, reorder mode: screen-reader name of the list

reorder.dragHandle.where: Perform setlist view, reorder mode: screen-reader label of a row's drag handle

reorder.moveUp.where: Perform setlist view, reorder mode: screen-reader label of a row's Move up button

reorder.moveDown.where: Perform setlist view, reorder mode: screen-reader label of a row's Move down button

reorder.failed.where: Perform setlist view: short error when a reorder could not be saved; the list has gone back

reorder.offline.where: Perform setlist view: short error when the leader tries to reorder with no connection
